title: Formatted output: values and representations
goal: Specify a reproducible textual report and explain which stream settings persist.

prerequisites.text: Modules 1–2: expressions, comparisons, types, references, and checked cin.
Follow the prerequisite links: cpp.unions-typedef-enums. New constructs are introduced before the assignment.

sections.title: A value is separate from its text
paragraphs: double stores a binary value; fixed and setprecision choose textual representation without increasing calculation precision. Money can use integral minor units and print whole and fractional parts separately.

Specify units, permitted signs, rounding, and separators. The lab price is an integer number of cents in 0…100000, quantity is 0…1000, and total is at most 100000000 cents. Integer arithmetic avoids decimal representation error.

sections.title: fixed and setprecision
paragraphs: With fixed, setprecision(2) from <iomanip> requests two digits after the decimal point. Without fixed, precision normally means significant digits. The setting affects subsequent insertions until changed.
std::defaultfloat restores general floating formatting but does not reset every stream flag. An independent report can use its own ostringstream with explicit settings. Here first trace cout’s state.

sections.title: Output precision persists
paragraphs: fixed specifies fractional digits for both following insertions.
steps: Read the contract and independently derive the expected result for the given input.
Trace state after each significant operation and identify the established preconditions.
Run the source, compare stdout and exit code, then check the additional cases.

sections.title: Width, fill, and alignment
paragraphs: setw(n) sets the minimum width of the next formatted field; longer values are not truncated. setfill('0') changes the fill character persistently. std::left and std::right also persist.

To print five cents, output 0, a dot, and the remainder with setw(2) and setfill('0'), yielding 0.05. Repeat setw for another field. Field width is a representation rule, not protection against oversized input.

sections.title: State manipulators
paragraphs: boolalpha prints true/false rather than 1/0 until noboolalpha. hex selects hexadecimal integer output; dec restores decimal. Avoid leaving an unexpected mode for the next report section.
\n adds a newline; endl additionally flushes the buffer. Repeated flushing is usually unnecessary in a batch sandbox. The environment’s overall output limit applies regardless of formatting.

sections.title: Width resets while fill persists
paragraphs: Only the next field receives the requested minimum width.
steps: Read the contract and independently derive the expected result for the given input.
Trace state after each significant operation and identify the established preconditions.
Run the source, compare stdout and exit code, then check the additional cases.

sections.title: Locale and portability
paragraphs: A text protocol should specify the decimal point and absence of grouping separators. Do not rely on incidental user locale. The examples explicitly form integer parts and a dot and use ASCII stdout.

Compare exact bytes separately from numeric closeness. 1.5 versus 1.50 may pass a numeric check while violating the interface. Approximate calculations need an explicit tolerance; setprecision does not repair the mathematics.

sections.title: Report checks
paragraphs: Test zero, one minor unit, a whole amount, and the maximum amount. Preserve expected strings including spaces and newlines. For setw, include a value longer than the field to avoid treating width as a length limit.
Check persistent fill and reset width on the next field. Input states require the same discipline next: flags belong to a stream and affect later operations until explicitly handled.

practice.title: Laboratory: Formatted output: values and representations
practice.task: Read a price in cents in 0…100000 and quantity in 0…1000; print total=X.YY. Require exactly two fields and reject extra input as invalid.
criteria: The contract matches the task and defines units, empty input, and extra data.
Every published case matches and two explained original tests are included.
Formatting changes representation, not value precision.
Do not confuse setprecision with storage precision. Do not expect setw to truncate long values.
Source, actual output, exit code, and a justified complexity explanation are preserved.

terms.definition: an operation changing stream formatting or state.
a field can grow and does not truncate the value.
floating formatting with a fixed number of fractional digits.
significant or fractional digit count according to formatting mode.
an integral minor-unit count instead of an approximate decimal fraction.
